name: Cinder-Gorged Legion
identity: Brass blood-demons and berserkers who kill or die. No guns. The bloodier the battle, the scarier they get.

rules.name: Blood-Tithe
rules.description: Every model destroyed (either side) adds 1 Tithe. Permanent army-wide unlocks: 5 → +1″ Move · 10 → melee [ONSLAUGHT 1] · 15 → [UNYIELDING 5+] · 20 → +1 Damage. No ranged weapons. When shot, a unit may [SURGE D6″] toward the shooter. Burning Vessels: at the end of each round, each unit that is not engaged suffers 1 Fatal Wound (it adds to the Tithe).

rules.name: Gamble — Unleashed Cinder-Fury
rules.description: When a unit activates, it may suffer D3 Fatal Wounds (they add to the Tithe): +1 Attack in melee and its melee weapons gain [CRASHING] this activation. (Risk: durability (voluntary).)

detachments.name: Red Tide
detachments.playstyle: Horde rush: zealots and daemons flood forward and feed the clock fast.

rules.name: Tide of Bodies
rules.description: Trooper units may Charge after one Move (not after a Sprint).

enhancements.name: Banner of Rage
enhancements.description: **Skull-Cleaver Champion** only. The attached unit gets +2″ Move.

detachments.name: Brass Host
detachments.playstyle: Armoured berserkers, juggernauts and engines: fewer bodies, harder hits.

rules.name: Brass Armour
rules.description: Elites and Behemoths ignore the Fatal Wounds from Unleashed Cinder-Fury on a 4+.

enhancements.name: Brass Collar of Defiance
enhancements.description: **Herald of the Cinder** only. The bearer has [WARD 4+].

enhancements.name: Hellsteed Harness
enhancements.description: **Brass Hellsteed Riders** only. +1 Damage on the charge.

stratagems.name: Crushing Charge
stratagems.turn: A Class 2+ unit finishes a Charge
stratagems.effect: Resolve Crushing Impact with no self-damage on 1s.

stratagems.name: Hateful Endurance
stratagems.turn: A unit is targeted by a Shoot action

stratagems.name: Skulls for the Pyre
stratagems.turn: A Leader is destroyed by this unit

detachments.name: Exalted Slaughter
detachments.playstyle: Hero-hammer: Champions and Heralds duel and snowball.

rules.name: Champion's Due
rules.description: When a Leader destroys an enemy Leader or Brute, unlock the next Tithe tier immediately.

enhancements.name: Axe of Ten Thousand Skulls
enhancements.description: **Skull-Cleaver Champion** only. The bearer's axe: +2 Attacks, +1 PEN.

enhancements.name: Deathmark Brand
enhancements.description: **Herald of the Cinder** only. The bearer's critical wounds trigger on 5+.

stratagems.name: Challenge Accepted
stratagems.effect: Its melee attacks gain [PRECISION] and +1 Damage against an enemy Leader this activation.

stratagems.name: Gore-Drenched
stratagems.effect: +1 to Hit for the rest of the round (healing belongs to the Sanguine Aristocracy).
